title: NIST WebBook: Aluminum is Al, molecular weight 26.9815386 amu
summary: The NIST Chemistry WebBook lists Aluminum as Al, molecular weight 26.9815386 amu, CAS 7429-90-5.
body: The NIST Chemistry WebBook entry for Aluminum, CAS Registry Number 7429-90-5, lists molecular formula Al and molecular weight 26.9815386 amu. The same entry's monoisotopic molecular weight is 26.98153863 amu. The IUPAC InChI on the entry is InChI=1S/Al. The molecular weight and the monoisotopic mass are two different fields. This card reports the catalog entry. It does not convert either field into a molar mass in grams, and it does not say that every real sample has that weight.
